title: Service Recovery by Age of an Erroneous Expedite Charge, Ostomy Supply Program
content:
**Service recovery schedule - Ostomy Supply Program.** When Larkfield corrects an expedited shipping charge posted in error against a shipment it sent expedited at no charge, an age service-recovery part follows the calendar days from the charge's posting date to today.

## The rule

More than 60 days adds the age recovery of USD 2.50 for every whole 30 days the charge has stood; more than 30 and at most 60 days adds the age recovery once; 30 days or fewer adds nothing. Whole 30 days are the days the charge has stood divided by 30, rounded down.

| Days the charge has stood | Age part |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | Nothing |
| More than 30 and at most 60 | USD 2.50 |
| More than 60 | USD 2.50 for every whole 30 days |

This part adds to the whole charge.

**Worked cases (hypothetical).** 30 days: nothing. 31 days: USD 2.50. 60 days: USD 2.50. 61 days: 2 whole 30-day periods, USD 5.00. 95 days: 3 whole periods, USD 7.50. 125 days: 4 whole periods, USD 10.00.
